name: Debt payoff
summary: Pay down debts one at a time in the order you choose, smallest balance or highest rate first, with projected payoff dates.
duration: Set by your debts and extra payment

onboarding.prompt: List each debt: a nickname, balance, interest rate and minimum payment.
onboarding.reaction: Thanks. Writing it down is a brave first step.

onboarding.prompt: How much extra can you put toward debt each month?

onboarding.reaction: Good pick. You can switch any time.

onboarding.prompt: When do you usually get paid?
Tap a time each month for a 15-minute money check.

phases.name: Get clear
benchmarks: All debts listed with due dates
actions: Set minimums to automatic where possible

phases.name: First win
actions: Extra goes to the target debt

phases.name: Roll it forward
actions: Freed-up payment rolls to the next debt
Quarterly re-check of rates and order

plan_blueprint.calendar: Due-date reminders for each minimum, a monthly money check at the chosen slot, and projected payoff dates for each debt (recalculated as you log balances).

approach_variants.habit: Same monthly routine: log balances, pay extra, done; streak of months on plan.
approach_variants.willpower: Debt-free countdown with a challenge to find extra each month.
approach_variants.time: Every payment and review is a calendar block; monthly review of time and amounts.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen low-cost reward each time a debt closes.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers statements, due dates and log-ins in one safe place (not in GoalKin).

guardrails: This plan is general education, not financial advice. Check big decisions with a qualified professional.
Account numbers and log-ins are never asked for; you enter only the totals you choose.
If you're behind on payments or contacted by collectors, a nonprofit credit counselor can help you review options.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A month without extra payments keeps minimums going and moves payoff dates out; nothing resets. A missed minimum prompts a quick checklist (pay as soon as possible, ask the lender about late fees) and a re-plan of the next month.

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
